sources.entry: Brisk - macOS app for submitting radars.

summary.one_liner: Brisk is a macOS app, written in Swift, for filing Apple Radars and optionally crossposting them to Open Radar.
summary.what_it_does: Brisk is a macOS app for submitting Radars (Apple bug reports) to Apple's Radar system. It can optionally crosspost each radar to Open Radar. The README says it uses Sonar to communicate with Apple's Radar web "APIs". It supports two-factor authentication, attachments, and saving radars as drafts. Installation options listed are downloading a packaged Brisk.app from releases, installing via Homebrew cask, or cloning the repo and running make install. Development uses make targets for building, installing dependencies, and opening the project in Xcode.
use_cases: file a bug report with Apple
attach files to Apple feedback reports
how_to_run: Download the latest Brisk.app from the releases page and copy it to your Applications directory
git clone the repo and run: make install
make dependencies, then open -a Xcode . to build in Xcode
notable: Files Apple Radars directly from a native macOS app
caveats: Depends on Apple's Radar web interface, which Sonar talks to; behavior may change
README does not describe limitations beyond the listed features
keywords: file apple bug report from mac
